title: Xuanwu Internal Conflict
next_chapter_hook: When the Xuanwu Sect Master tore apart the last shred of his sanity and the forbidden power roared out from the depths of its seal, Chen Ji realized—the fire he had personally ignited had burned in a direction beyond his control.

text.content: The characters on the fourth page of the Tianji Record had not yet faded, and those eyes that transcended heavenly dao had already locked onto him—within seven days, his fake death identity would be completely exposed. Chen Ji slowly closed the fragment, his fingertips tracing the scorched edges, yet a faint smile curved his lips. "Seven days?" he murmured to himself, "That's enough." Before his words faded, the transmission jade talisman in his sleeve suddenly burned hot—the chess game at Xuanwu was even more spectacular than he had anticipated.

dialogue.content: (Far away at the Xuanwu Sect Council Hall thousands of miles distant, Elder Zhao Tieshan abruptly stood, his murky old eyes blazing with sharp light, his voice exploding like thunder) "Everyone! Today I shall expose a shocking conspiracy—Sect Master Han Yuan has been secretly colluding with the imperial court, betraying our Xuanwu Sect's thousand-year foundation!"

text.content: The hall erupted in chaos. Dozens of elders exchanged glances, some astonished, some suspicious, and others showing fleeting glints in their eyes—those were the pieces Chen Ji had secretly bought off long ago. Chen Ji sat in the shadows, using the Tianji Record Fragment to peer into the situation here, his smile growing increasingly knowing. Three months of laying groundwork, and finally it was time to harvest.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's figure appeared in the shadows at the corner of the hall. He coldly watched Elder Zhao Tieshan's performance, yet in his heart he was rapidly calculating. Chen Ji, Chen Ji, you think this old man doesn't know you're pulling strings behind the scenes? Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one thing—what this old man wants has never been an intact Xuanwu Sect.

text.content: Sect Master Han Yuan sat in the main seat, his face ashen. He never imagined that the Grand Elder he had personally promoted would turn on him at this moment. What chilled him even more was that nearly one-third of the elders and disciples in the hall had begun whispering, their gazes toward him carrying more scrutiny and wavering.

dialogue.content: Han Lie stomped forward fiercely, bellowing: "Zhao Tieshan! You slander with malice! My father has devoted himself tirelessly to the Xuanwu Sect—how dare you defame him!" His fists clenched until they cracked, Xuanwu True Yuan forming a pale golden armor over his body, his battle intent awe-inspiring. Yet several core disciples beside him quietly retreated half a step—that subtle movement made Han Lie's heart tighten.

text.content: Chen Ji observed everything clearly from the shadows. The "evidence" Zhao Tieshan presented was merely some correspondence taken out of context, but enough to plant the seeds of doubt in everyone's hearts. What was truly lethal were those disciples he had already subtly influenced with the Tianji Record—their wavering at critical moments would become the final straw that broke the camel's back. The taste of manipulating the chess game of destiny was truly intoxicating.

choices.text: Continue watching from the sidelines, let the fire burn on its own
choices.description: Maintaining mystery while letting Xuanwu Sect collapse entirely from internal exhaustion—this is the most stable "delayed satisfaction" strategy.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to control the situation in the first instance
choices.visible_reward: Xuanwu Sect severely weakened, the balance among the three major sects completely shattered
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may be fishing in troubled waters in the shadows

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，将身形完全融入阴影之中。 Zhao Tieshan's performance grew ever more brilliant, and in the distance Ling Yuan began stirring—how interesting this play was becoming.

choices.text: Give the Sect Master a "small hint"
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to send an anonymous tip to Sect Master Han Yuan, letting him know the Grand Elder has long been manipulated, steering the situation toward another climax.
choices.visible_reward: Sect Master exposes the truth publicly, Zhao Tieshan utterly disgraced, Xuanwu Sect division accelerates
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Record activity may be noticed by Ling Yuan

text.content: A flash of spiritual light suddenly burst through Han Yuan's mind. He猛地抬头，目光如电般扫向 Zhao Tieshan—turns out! The pieces controlled by the Tianji Record, he should have seen through them long ago!

choices.text: Personally step in to mock the Grand Elder
choices.description: Appear suddenly as a mysterious figure, publicly expose the truth that Zhao Tieshan was being manipulated, enjoying the ultimate pleasure of "playing dumb to eat the tiger."

choices.visible_reward: Zhao Tieshan collapses on the spot, Sect Master leans toward Chen Ji's faction, Ling Yuan's conspiracy exposed ahead of time

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stepped out of the void with a light laugh, clasping his hands in greeting) "Elder Zhao, long time no see. Those traces of 'destiny's threads' on your body are truly beautiful—unfortunately, the puppet cannot see where the puppeteer is."

text.content: As Chen Ji had expected, Zhao Tieshan's face instantly turned deathly pale under the "heavenly hint." He instinctively glanced at his right wrist—where an almost invisible black thread marked the spot where Chen Ji had planted the "destiny's threads" three months prior. If the Sect Master could see through this, naturally the other elders began whispering among themselves.

dialogue.content: A flash of astonishment crossed Ling Yuan's eyes before transforming into an icy smile. "Interesting." he murmured to himself, "This kid actually dares to make a move in such a situation… Chen Ji, Chen Ji, are you forcing this old man to act ahead of schedule?" His sleeves concealed hands secretly formed seals, and a covert transmission was quietly sent out.

text.content: Sect Master Han Yuan abruptly slammed the table and rose, his voice like a great bell: "Zhao Tieshan! What do you have to say for yourself! This old man treated you generously, yet you let yourself be manipulated by someone with destiny arts and turned around to bite me!" He waved his hand broadly, several streaks of golden light shot forth, pinning Zhao Tieshan in place. "Guards! Take this traitor!"

dialogue.content: Han Lie froze for an instant, then reacted. His fist wrapped in Xuanwu True Yuan smashed toward Zhao Tieshan with a thunderous roar: "Old fool! My father trusted you, yet you dared betray!" The拳风呼啸，带着少年天才的满腔怒火。 Zhao Tieshan, pinned in place unable to dodge, his eyes full of despair—he never understood, how could he, a Grand Elder, end up at others' mercy?

text.content: Yet just as Han Lie's fist was about to strike Zhao Tieshan's face, a sinister laugh suddenly rang out from outside the hall. "Han Sect Master, what great authority you wield." A black shadow swept into the hall like a specter—it was Ling Yuan. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze sweeping over everyone present before finally fixing on a spot in the void—the very direction where Chen Ji was hiding. "Unfortunately, today's drama has more than one puppeteer."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan has locked onto Chen Ji's position, the situation is spiraling out of control—how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Turn the tables: Expose Ling Yuan as the true mastermind
choices.description: Publicly expose the fact that Ling Yuan colluded with the Demonic Path in front of everyone, shifting everyone's attention from himself onto Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan becomes the target of all, Chen Ji's identity temporarily preserved
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have backup plans

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji calmly straightened his sleeves, surveying the crowd) "Senior Ling, you say there is only one puppeteer? But I happen to have heard that the thread controlling Elder Zhao originally flew out from your study."

choices.text: Retreat strategically: Pretend to be a victim framed by Ling Yuan
choices.description: Disguise as an innocent person framed by Ling Yuan, deflecting the conflict toward Ling Yuan while protecting oneself—this is the most stable "playing dumb to eat the tiger" strategy.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan and Xuanwu Sect become enemies, Chen Ji reaps the benefits
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may expose the deception on the spot

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji wore an aggrieved expression, shouting loudly) "Wronged, Senior Ling! You've had me hunted for days, and now you're framing me—what justice is this!" The corner of his eye caught Han Yuan's sudden change of expression, and he暗笑——老狐狸，上钩了.

choices.text: Retreat directly: Of the thirty-six strategies, retreat is best
choices.description: Things have come to this—continuing to entangled will only expose more. Better to withdraw in time, leaving the mess for Ling Yuan and Xuanwu to tear each other apart.
choices.visible_cost: Loses the chance for face-to-face humiliation
choices.visible_reward: Preserves oneself, Xuanwu internal strife continues to intensify
choices.risk_hint: May be tracked by Ling Yuan

text.content: Ling Yuan's smile froze on his face—he never expected Chen Ji to directly bolt in front of everyone! This kid is truly a troublemaker who defies all conventions!

Yet Chen Ji's true choice surprised everyone. He didn't run, didn't retort—he slowly stepped out of the void, a meaningful smile on his face. His gaze passed over Ling Yuan and fixed directly on Sect Master Han Yuan. "Sect Master Han," he clasped his hands in greeting, his tone terrifyingly calm, "do you think the true mastermind behind all this is truly only Zhao Tieshan?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's eyelids twitched violently. "Chen Ji, you—" Before he could finish, Chen Ji had already raised his hand. A strand of heavenly energy formed a screen of light that slowly unfurled before everyone. On it赫然显示着 Zhao Tieshan and Ling Yuan's secret meetings, as well as the detailed process of Ling Yuan teaching him the "art of manipulating destiny." "Senior Ling," Chen Ji said with a smile, "Elder Zhao certainly remembers your guidance."

text.content: The hall fell into deathly silence. Han Yuan's eyes blazed with fury as he stared at Ling Yuan, his voice squeezing through his teeth: "Ling Yuan… This old man treated you as a close friend, yet you stabbed me in the back!" Ling Yuan's face was ashen—he never imagined Chen Ji possessed such ironclad evidence. What infuriated him more was that this kid had been setting up moves from the very beginning—he was the one who had been outcalculated!

dialogue.content: Han Lie flew into a rage, Xuanwu True Yuan surging forth: "Ling Yuan! I'll kill you!" He threw a punch, easily blocked by Ling Yuan. The two engaged in fierce combat, and the Xuanwu disciples instantly split into several factions—some helping the Sect Master surround Ling Yuan, others watching, and yet others seizing the chaos to flee. The entire hall turned into utter chaos.

choice.prompt: Xuanwu Sect has completely fallen into chaos—how should Chen Ji wrap things up while escaping?

choices.text: Taunt one more time before leaving

choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan humiliated, Chen Ji's reputation soars

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji waved at Ling Yuan, his smile radiant) "Senior Ling, the chess game is over. Take your time playing. Your student will take his leave—and oh, the orchid in your study is blooming beautifully. Until we meet again." Before the words even faded, his figure had vanished into the void.

choices.text: Rescue Zhao Tieshan as a witness on the way out
choices.description: Take Zhao Tieshan away in the chaos, keeping him as leverage against Ling Yuan for future use—it's a long-term strategic move.

text.content: Chen Ji silently released Zhao Tieshan from his restraints, whispering in his ear: "Elder Zhao, want to live? Come with me." Zhao Tieshan shuddered all over, nodding without hesitation—compared to Ling Yuan, this youth who could manipulate his destiny seemed more worth betting on.

choices.text: Stand by and watch Ling Yuan and Han Yuan tear each other apart
choices.description: Find a safe spot to enjoy the show, wait for both sides to exhaust each other before coming out to clean up.

choices.visible_reward: Xuanwu Sect severely weakened, Chen Ji reaps the benefits

text.content: As Ling Yuan and Han Yuan fought fiercely and Han Lie's addition made the chaos even more tangled, Chen Ji hid in the shadows watching this scene, his smile growing increasingly knowing—truly, watching others tear each other apart is life's greatest pleasure.

Amid the chaos, Sect Master Han Yuan finally erupted with the fury he had suppressed for so long. He laughed wildly toward the sky, his laughter carrying a hint of madness: "Good! Excellent Ling Yuan! Excellent Xuanwu Sect!" His laughter echoed through the hall, making everyone's skin crawl. Then he suddenly bit his tongue, spewing a mouthful of refined blood onto the ground. "Since you all want to destroy my foundation—then let me show you what the true depth of Xuanwu Sect truly is!"

The earth shuddered violently. A pillar of black light erupted from the depths of the hall, tearing the roof of the entire Council Hall clean off. Within that black light, a massive silhouette writhed in the shadows—the forbidden power sealed by generations of Xuanwu Sect Masters, a wisp of soul from an ancient fiend capable of destroying heaven and earth! Ling Yuan's face instantly changed drastically: "Madman! Han Yuan, you've gone mad!"

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He had thought this was merely a normal sect internal conflict, never expecting Han Yuan to be this insane—summoning forbidden power, no one present would likely survive. The fragment of the Tianji Record in his sleeve suddenly burned hot, and the characters on the fourth page appeared once more: "The gears of destiny have begun to turn, the price… is about to arrive."

The awakened forbidden power's aura instantly swept across the entire area. Ling Yuan bore the brunt, knocked backward by the black light; Han Lie tried his hardest to condense his Xuanwu armor yet still coughed blood from the shock; even Chen Ji hiding in the shadows felt that suffocating pressure. He realized—the fire he had personally ignited had burned in a direction beyond his control.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan barely stabilized himself within the black light, shouting toward Chen Ji's direction: "Chen Ji! Are you satisfied?! Is this the result you wanted?!" His voice carried suppressed fury and a hint of barely concealed fear—he hadn't expected Han Yuan to be this insane either.

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He merely stood quietly in the void, gazing down at that chaotic hall, at Han Yuan's mad smile, at Ling Yuan's disheveled figure, at Han Lie's heroic stance fighting through blood. His plan had been executed perfectly—Xuanwu Sect truly fell into division—but the price seemed far more devastating than he had imagined.

The characters on the fourth page of the Tianji Record shifted once more: "Causation is sealed, the price approaches. The seven-day deadline remains unchanged." Chen Ji gazed at these words, then suddenly laughed softly. "Interesting." he murmured, "The Heavenly Eye watches, the forbidden power awakens, and my identity… has seven days left." He raised his eyes toward that sky shrouded in black light, a strange glint flickering in his eyes. "This play has only just begun."
